summary: Nothing contradicts the SRD. CMB-05 and its test are the core cover items. The test checks the AC bonuses, best-degree-only and the Total Cover refusal, but not the Dexterity-save bonus, creature-as-Half-Cover, or the opposite-side clause, so it under-asserts. SPL-05 and its test depend on the Total Cover vs area effects ambiguity: they assume cover shields against a cone, which the unit doesn't say. SPL-06 and its test are consistent. The SPELLS-05 scenario and test are consistent: the no-cover result is a Sacred Flame exception. EXPL-03 and CLS-ROG-02 (scenarios and tests) are not related, since cover is only a precondition for Hide. In the code, combat.py:678 is the Total Cover refusal and is consistent. The other page-15 matches are Opportunity Attacks, melee reach and mounted combat, so they are not related. I didn't read game.py cover_between or the spell cover code at spells.py:129, 444, 471 and 920 in detail, so I gave them no verdicts.
